output.reason: [ev-d55f4ac0a53f] shows only that spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage on clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io goes from true to false between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. The validator, citing [ev-9889c9b8706d] and [ev-e08924afdc47], confirms v1beta1 is still an API version in both releases. Nothing here fails, is rejected or must run for this upgrade. The change text puts the migration "before a later release removes v1beta1", so it is a future obligation and the kind should be deprecation (review), not migration-required.

correction.statement: From 0.16.0 the storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io moves from v1beta1 to v1. v1beta1 is still served, so existing ClusterSecretStore objects keep working but stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. They must be migrated before a later release removes v1beta1.

consequence.statement: Existing ClusterSecretStore objects keep working after the upgrade but stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. If they are not migrated, a later release that removes v1beta1 would leave them stored in an unserved version.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta1, rewrite all ClusterSecretStore objects so they are stored as v1. Then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions on the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD.
